text: Will the first published January 2027 container throughput for Port Calder be below 400,000 TEU?
resolution_rule: Resolves 1 if the first published January 2027 value is strictly below 400000 TEU; resolves 0 if it is 400000 TEU or above. If no qualifying value is published by the resolution deadline, the outcome is unresolved (never 0 and never 0.5).

resolution_source.name: Port Calder Authority monthly statistical bulletin (fictional)
